description: Bassins de rétention sur RN - DIR Ouest is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geobretagne.fr. Geolocation and associated data of stormwater retention and sewerage basins on the DIR West road network. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Retention basins on RN — DIR West" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include diro, assainissement routier, Bretagne, bassin, données ouvertes, Pays de la Loire. The listing shows 2021-12-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
